name: Rishav Chourasia
tagline: Full-stack software engineer. React and TypeScript in front, Spring Boot, Kafka and Redis behind it.
bio: I'm a full-stack software engineer. I build the screen people touch and the services behind it, and I care about the parts most people only feel — pages that respond instantly, systems that stay correct under load, and software that keeps working when something goes wrong.

Day to day that means React, Next.js and TypeScript on the frontend, and Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Redis and Kafka on the backend. I like owning a feature end to end: from a vague ticket to an API, a UI, tests and a deploy that's measured in production.
values: Systems that scale past the first sprint

stats.label: Faster builds from a shared component library
